title: IFR Currency: 6-6-HIT
hook: Legal to file IFR today? Let's check your math.

scenes.narration: Hangar coffee, logbook open. Tomorrow's trip is hard I F R, and your last logged approach was... seven months ago. March. Alright kid — are you even legal to file?
Seven months since your last six approaches. Can you file I F R tomorrow — yes or no? Commit.

No. The rule is six-six-H-I-T: within the preceding SIX months, SIX approaches, plus Holding, plus Intercepting and Tracking courses. Why six months? Instrument skills rust faster than any other skill in your logbook.
At month seven you're in the grace period — months seven through twelve. You can regain currency yourself: safety pilot, or a sim. But you cannot file I F R until you do.
Past twelve months total? Now it's an instrument proficiency check with an instructor. Not a punishment, kid — the punishment is what the clouds had planned.
Eyes off the screen. What's the H, the I, and the T — and what happens at month thirteen?

Six approaches, holding, intercepting, tracking, every six months. Six more to fix it yourself. Then an I P C. Your rating is a gym membership — it never expires, it just quietly stops working when you do.
From the lost-comm lesson — the radio dies, no new route. First letter of the route order. Go.
Sixty-one fifty-seven, paragraphs c and d. Then go log some approaches.

quiz.question: Your last 6 approaches were logged 7 months ago. Can you act as PIC under IFR tomorrow?
choices: No — you're in the grace period and must regain currency first
Yes — the rating covers you for 12 months
No — you need an IPC immediately
quiz.explanation: Past 6 months you can't file IFR; during months 7–12 you regain currency yourself (safety pilot/sim). An IPC is only required past 12. (61.57)

quiz.question: Your currency lapsed 3 months ago (month 9 of 12). You may regain it by:
choices: Flying approaches with a safety pilot or in an approved sim
Filing IFR and logging 6 approaches solo in IMC
quiz.explanation: During the 6-month grace period you can regain currency yourself (safety pilot/sim/instructor) — but you can't act as PIC under IFR until you do.

quiz.question: More than 12 months since you were last instrument current. What's required?
quiz.explanation: 61.57(d): once the grace period ends, you need an IPC from an authorized instructor/examiner.
